results.title: Trinity Madison In Demand For Advising On Defective Building Work Disputes
results.description: Trinity Madison Construction Services confirmed to Eleven Media strong demand exists for technical assessments in family and construction law disputes.

results.title: After AAI, forest dept backs Dhalbhumgarh airport project
results.description: After Airports Authority of India (AAI), the Jamshedpur divisional forest officer (DFO) has also forwarded the compliance report to the Jharkhand forest department on the 19-point queries raised by the Union ministry of environment, forest and climate change (MoEFC) in regards to the proposed Dhalbhumgarh airport worth ₹300 crore, officials said on Saturday
